steps.step: E1.B_theta = {1, e^{i th}, -1, -e^{i th}}: cross-ratio = -tan^2(th/2) (one real modulus); square <=> th = pi/2 <=> lambda = -1
E2.conformal stabiliser of 4 marks = V4 x (stabiliser of lambda in S3): order-2 points {-1,1/2,2} (D4), order-3 points e^{+-i pi/3} (A4); disjoint
E3.NO-GO: no four-mark seam carries BOTH a conformal order-4 clock and a conformal order-3 family clock (S4 never conformal)
steps.detail: one of them must be a non-conformal (mapping-class / Fuchs) monodromy

steps.step: E4.on H^1 (dim 3): D4 acts reducibly (<chi,chi>=2: 1+2), the full mapping-class image S4 = W(A3) irreducibly (<chi,chi>=1)
steps.detail: Mod(S^2,4) -> S4 is onto for EVERY lambda; the order-3 element is a braid monodromy, conformal only at j=0

steps.step: E5.extremal principle FAILS to select the square: log det' Delta is critical at tau=i but a SADDLE; its maximum is hexagonal (j=0)
E6.raw station clock R: projectively the 4-cycle of the stations, det R = 1, R^4 = -I, R^8 = I; J R J = R^-1
steps.detail: the SU(4) lift with g^4 = -I found in E8 (C10) is already the raw seam's antiperiodic station clock

steps.step: E7.an order-4 Moebius map preserving the seam circle is a rotation; every orbit on the circle is harmonic (lambda = -1 / 2), for all phi
steps.detail: elliptic order-4 element of PSU(1,1) is conjugate to z->iz; orbit {a,ia,-a,-ia}

steps.step: E8.centraliser of Spin(10) in E8 has Lie algebra su(4) exactly (Cartan 3 + 12 roots = 15, no extra u(1)): det-1 lift forced
